errors.busctl_missing: busctl is required but was not found on PATH

player_filter_mode.label: Player Filter Mode
player_filter_mode.description: Ignore or only allow matching players.

player_filter_list.label: Player Filter Rules
player_filter_list.description: Case-insensitive substring rules matched against player identity and desktop entry.

primary_source.label: Primary Lyrics Source
primary_source.description: Tried first when searching for lyrics.

prefer_player_lyrics.label: Prefer Player Lyrics
prefer_player_lyrics.description: Use lyrics embedded in the player (MPRIS) before network sources, when available.

timeout.label: Request Timeout
timeout.description: Abort a lyrics request after this many milliseconds.

advance.label: Lyric Advance
advance.description: Positive values show lyrics earlier; negative values later (ms).

show_secondary_line.label: Show Secondary Line
show_secondary_line.description: Show a smaller, dimmer second line under the main lyric when available.

secondary_line_content.label: Secondary Line Content
secondary_line_content.description: What to show on the second line (NetEase/QQ when the track provides it).

bar_width.label: Bar Max Width
bar_width.description: Maximum (adaptive) or locked (fixed) width in pixels.

bar_width_mode.label: Bar Width Mode
bar_width_mode.description: Follow lyric length or keep a fixed width.

bar_hide.label: Hide When No Track Is Active
bar_hide.description: Hide the bar widget when no track is active.

bar_dot.label: Show Status Dot
bar_dot.description: Show a colored state indicator before the lyric text.

secondary_primary_font_size.label: Primary Font Size (Two-line)
secondary_primary_font_size.description: Main lyric size when the secondary line is shown.

secondary_line_gap.label: Line Gap
secondary_line_gap.description: Vertical gap between the two lines. Negative pulls them closer.

padding_left.label: Left Padding
padding_left.description: Space between the capsule edge and content on the left (px).

padding_right.label: Right Padding
padding_right.description: Space between the content and the capsule edge on the right (px).

text_align.label: Text Align
text_align.description: Horizontal alignment of the lyric lines (most noticeable with fixed width and ellipsis).
